puzzles.title: The paired morning signals
puzzles.subtitle: Night Symbols
puzzles.story: A faded signal ledger uses equal numbers of suns and moons. Restore it without triples or repeated rows or columns; every surviving mark must stay in place.
puzzles.difficultyEvidence: 15 fixed symbols seed every row and column of an 8x8 board; pairs and balance leave substantial work for line comparisons. Provisional editorial tier.

puzzles.title: The conservator's order
puzzles.subtitle: Night Symbols
puzzles.story: Seven ranks belong on each shelf and in each column, with no repeats. The surviving comparisons order neighbouring entries; combine them with the six fixed ranks.
puzzles.difficultyEvidence: Six givens meet 12 horizontal and 12 vertical comparisons on a 7x7 Latin square; combine order bounds with two-axis exclusions. Provisional editorial tier.
